title: Anna's Travel Blog
text:
Last year, Anna started a travel blog. She wanted to share photos and stories from her trips. At first, only her family read her posts. She wrote a new post every Sunday.

After six months, Anna had more than one thousand readers. Many of them wrote comments and asked questions about her favorite places. Anna now answers every comment, because she thinks her readers are very important. She says that blogging takes time, but it is a lot of fun.

questions.text: What did Anna want to share on her blog?
options: Photos and stories from her trips

questions.text: How often did Anna write a new post?
What can we infer about Anna from the passage?
options: She stopped writing after six months
She only writes for her family

questions.text: Why does Anna answer every comment?
options: She is bored with her blog
She wants to show that readers matter to her
Her readers asked her to stop writing

vocabulary.definition: journeys to a place, usually for a short time
people who read a book, article or blog
short written replies that people post under an article
writing and posting regularly on a website

paragraph_translations: Минулого року Анна почала вести блог про подорожі. Вона хотіла ділитися фотографіями та історіями зі своїх поїздок. Спочатку її пости читала тільки сім'я. Вона писала новий пост щонеділі.

Через півроку у Анни було понад тисячу читачів. Багато з них залишали коментарі та ставили запитання про її улюблені місця. Тепер Анна відповідає на кожен коментар, бо вважає своїх читачів дуже важливими. Вона каже, що ведення блогу займає багато часу, але це дуже весело.
